name: motion-ease-elastic-out
title: Elastic Out
description: Vượt quá rồi rung qua lại nhiều lần mới dừng; vui nhộn, không dùng cho phong cách cao cấp.out(1, 0.3)).

moworks.author: moworks

options.graph: a canvas to draw the curve on (a teaching guide; none by default)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 100 % on elastic.out(1, 0.3), 1000 ms: 2^(−10p)·sin((10p − 0.75)·2π/3) + 1, first peak 137 % at 13.5 % of the time, then shrinking swings. Rule: playful; never for premium looks. Small demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (1 s) · amplitude (1) · period (0.3).
